NTPC Explores Overseas Markets for Green Fuels

NTPC is in discussions with potential international buyers for green ammonia and low-carbon fuels. The company is developing a green hydrogen hub in Andhra Pradesh and has engaged in talks with countries including Japan, South Korea, and Germany regarding exports. NTPC Chairman Gurdeep Singh mentioned these discussions at an event organized by the Indian Chamber of Commerce.
